question: Which of the following chemicals is used to cause artificial rain (cloud seeding)?
solution:
The correct answer is **__Silver Iodide__**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• Artificial rain is created by seeding clouds with **Silver Iodide.**
 
• Seeding of Clouds refers to the process of making precipitation fall using substances like dry ice, and silver iodide.
 
• Cloud seeding chemicals include silver iodide, potassium iodide and dry ice.
 
• Cloud seeding is an artificial way to create moisture in the clouds so as to cause rainfall.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **__Important Points__**

 
 

 
 
**Silver Iodide**

 
 

 
 
 
 
• Highly photosensitive
 
• Used as antiseptic and in cloud seeding
 
• Chemical Formula: AgI
 
 
 
 

 **Hydrogen Bromide**
 
 
 
• Chemical Formula: HBr
 
• Colorless gas
 
• Soluble in water
 
• Used in pharmaceuticals, industrial drying, etc.
 
 
 
 

 **Silver Oxide**
 
 
 
• Chemical formula: Ag₂O
 
• The form is like Black brown powder
 
• Used in alkaline batteries.
 
 
 
 

 **Aluminium Sulphide **
 
 
 
• Chemical Formula: Al₂S₃
 
• Colorless and has crystal like structure.
 
• Used in hydrogen sulfide, papermaking industry.
